name: @sigmacamellia/dsh-dynamic-workflow
description: Typechecked TypeScript multi-agent dynamic workflow plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): parallel subagents, SQLite durable journal (resume / amend / holes / escalations), vertical spine timeline, and live dashboard artifacts. Ported from ZCode (Apache-2.0).

scripts.test: node vendor/dynamic-workflow/scripts/generate-libs.mjs && node scripts/dsh-test-config.mjs && tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.test.json tests/smoke/engine-smoke.ts && tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.test.json tests/dsh/governor.ts && tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.test.json tests/dsh/hardening.ts && tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.test.json tests/dsh/quota-resume.ts && tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.test.json tests/dsh/snippet.ts && tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.test.json tests/dsh/tool-schema.ts && DWF_TEST_HOOK=1 tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.test.json tests/dsh/integration.ts && DWF_TEST_HOOK=1 tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.test.json tests/dsh/wire.ts && DWF_TEST_HOOK=1 tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.test.json tests/dsh/drafts.ts && DWF_TEST_HOOK=1 tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.test.json tests/dsh/amend-inflight.ts && DWF_TEST_HOOK=1 tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.test.json tests/dsh/budget.ts && DWF_TEST_HOOK=1 tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.test.json tests/dsh/modes.ts && DWF_TEST_HOOK=1 tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.test.json tests/dsh/audit-regressions.ts
scripts.test:bundle: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/dsh-test-config.mjs && DWF_TEST_HOOK=1 DWF_PLUGIN=lib tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.test.json tests/dsh/integration.ts && DWF_TEST_HOOK=1 DWF_PLUGIN=lib tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.test.json tests/dsh/wire.ts && DWF_TEST_HOOK=1 DWF_PLUGIN=lib tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.test.json tests/dsh/audit-regressions.ts
scripts.test:client: node scripts/build.mjs --client-only && node scripts/dsh-test-config.mjs && mkdir -p .tmp && DWF_FIXTURE_DIR=.tmp DWF_TEST_HOOK=1 tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.test.json tests/dsh/integration.ts && tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.test.json tests/preview/make-fixtures.ts .tmp/run-main.json .tmp/fixtures.json && node tests/client/bundle-load.mjs .tmp/fixtures.json
scripts.test:vendor: node vendor/dynamic-workflow/scripts/generate-libs.mjs && vitest run --config vitest.vendor.config.mts && vitest run --config vitest.config.mts
